description: This file contains benchmark classes for measuring the performance of message dequeuing in an Orleans streaming context using ADO.NET with SQL Server. It defines a specific benchmark class for SQL Server and an abstract base class with setup and execution logic for the benchmarks.

classes.name: SqlServerMessageDequeuingBenchmark
classes.description: A concrete benchmark class for SQL Server that inherits from the abstract MessageDequeuingBenchmark class, setting up the environment specific to SQL Server.

classes.name: MessageDequeuingBenchmark
classes.description: An abstract base class that defines the setup and benchmarking logic for message dequeuing performance tests, parameterized by database invariants and size parameters.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, clears connection pools, and prepares the database and query objects.

methods.name: Async
methods.description: Asynchronous setup routine called within GlobalSetup to initialize payload, queues, and database connections.

methods.name: IterationSetup
methods.description: Prepares the database state before each benchmark iteration, including truncating message tables and generating test messages.

methods.name: Async
methods.description: Asynchronous routine within IterationSetup to populate the database with test messages.

methods.name: GetStreamMessages
methods.description: Benchmark method that simulates retrieving stream messages concurrently from multiple queues.
